previous_statement: The right hand side (sigma-sigma_g)*tau/4 + nu_v*(2+4*delta) is nonnegative: 1.2 gives sigma-sigma_g>=0, tau=sqrt(delta)>0, nu_v is a sum of negative parts and hence nonnegative, and 2+4*delta>0.
new_statement: The right hand side (sigma-sigma_g)*tau/4 + nu_v*(2+4*delta) is nonnegative: writing C=conv W and d_j=dist_1(p_j,C), def-invisible-mass gives sigma=sum_{d_j>0} max(P_vj,0), while the root definition of sigma_g gives sigma_g=sum_{d_j>tau/4} max(P_vj,0) with tau=sqrt(delta); since delta>0, {j:d_j>tau/4} is contained in {j:d_j>0}, so sigma-sigma_g>=0. Also tau/4>=0, nu_v>=0 as a row negative mass, and 2+4*delta>0, so both summands are nonnegative.
